summary.headline: Combustion in the Triplicities
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Mars combust in the watery triplicity, predicting sedition, war, disease, weather disturbances, and calamity across regions including Babylon, Fars, Lesser Armenia, and Turkestan, with modifications from Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon. The text then turns to Venus combust in the triplicities, citing Kamāl al-Dīn Muḥaqqiq Ṭūsī’s Safīnat al-Aḥkām and Abū Maʿshar Balkhī’s Mukhtaṣar al-Asrār on rain, kings, women, markets, illness, and famine.
